pageDescription: Protecting the children and vulnerable adults in our community is a sacred responsibility.
commitmentText: At Christ The King, the safety of children, youth, and vulnerable adults is paramount. We take proactive steps to create a safe environment where everyone can worship, learn, and grow.

requirements.title: Background Screening
requirements.description: All volunteers who work with children and youth undergo a comprehensive background check.

requirements.title: MinistrySafe Training
requirements.description: Completion of MinistrySafe training is required before serving in children's or youth ministry.

requirements.title: Two-Adult Rule
requirements.description: We maintain a two-adult minimum in all settings with children and youth.

requirements.title: Clear Policies
requirements.description: Written policies and procedures guide all children's and youth activities.
